label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 26
title: MVP: agent status + per-agent control UI (start/stop/pause/resume/cancel) once backend supports it
body: Dashboard UI: show per-agent status (live) and per-agent control operations (start/stop/pause/resume/cancel) plus the existing project/pipeline controls (stop/pause/resume, approve/reject, answer prompts, rerun scopes). DEPENDS ON backend item BI-0046 (backend-first): the agent-control channel + status must exist in the pipeline first. Follows the dual-backlog convention (BI-0042/BI-0024).
